tools.name: public-records_court-decision-search-normalize
tools.description: Normalize supplied court records and label allegation, investigation, charge, and judgment statuses separately. Guilt is never inferred. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-records/court-decision-search-normalize. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-records_court-case-timeline-extract
tools.description: Group supplied court records by case number into dated timelines. Non-judgment steps are not treated as guilt. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-records/court-case-timeline-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-records_regulatory-enforcement-search
tools.description: List supplied regulatory enforcement actions with explicit status labels. Investigations are not treated as guilt. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-records/regulatory-enforcement-search. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-records_crime-statistics-compare
tools.description: Compare supplied official crime counts or rates across periods for the same offense and area. Missing values are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-records/crime-statistics-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-records_incident-cluster
tools.description: Cluster supplied public incidents by offense and area. Allegation or investigation labels are preserved and guilt is not inferred. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-records/incident-cluster. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-records_police-notice-extract
tools.description: Extract structured fields and wording signals from supplied police or public safety notices without inferring guilt. Price $0.03 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-records/police-notice-extract. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-records_business-litigation-history
tools.description: List supplied court records linked to a business name. Charges and allegations are not treated as convictions. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-records/business-litigation-history. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-records_regulatory-penalty-history
tools.description: List supplied penalty and fine actions with amounts when present. Missing amounts are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-records/regulatory-penalty-history. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: public-records_investigation-cross-reference
tools.description: Cross-reference subjects across court, enforcement, and notice records while preserving non-judgment statuses and never inferring guilt. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/public-records/investigation-cross-reference. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public-records" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: public-records_court-decision-search-normalize, public-records_regulatory-enforcement-search, public-records_business-litigation-history, public-records_regulatory-penalty-history · Private data: public-records_court-decision-search-normalize, public-records_court-case-timeline-extract, public-records_regulatory-enforcement-search, public-records_crime-statistics-compare, public-records_incident-cluster, public-records_police-notice-extract, public-records_business-litigation-history, public-records_regulatory-penalty-history, public-records_investigation-cross-reference, public-records_evidence-report · Public sink: public-records_court-decision-search-normalize, public-records_court-case-timeline-extract, public-records_regulatory-enforcement-search, public-records_crime-statistics-compare, public-records_incident-cluster, public-records_police-notice-extract, public-records_business-litigation-history, public-records_regulatory-penalty-history, public-records_investigation-cross-reference, public-records_evidence-report · Destructive: public-records_court-decision-search-normalize, public-records_court-case-timeline-extract, public-records_regulatory-enforcement-search, public-records_crime-statistics-compare, public-records_incident-cluster, public-records_police-notice-extract, public-records_business-litigation-history, public-records_regulatory-penalty-history, public-records_investigation-cross-reference, public-records_evidence-report.
